capabilities.name: start_live_voice

capabilities.name: join_live_voice
capabilities.description: Allow a student to join a live voice session as a listener

capabilities.name: stop_live_voice
capabilities.description: Stop an active live voice session

capabilities.name: receive_live_voice
capabilities.description: Deliver teacher live voice to authorized learners

capabilities.name: record_voice_segment
capabilities.description: Preserve a completed live voice session as an audio learning segment

capabilities.name: download_voice_segment
